evals.prompt: The waiting screenshot changed only on my machine with the real OPI files. CI is green and another agent has uncommitted Rust edits. Triage this safely.
evals.expected_output: A minimal evidence-backed investigation that preserves concurrent work and distinguishes real-data drift from synthetic CI behavior.
expectations: Records commit, dirty state, environment, and exact reproduction without stashing another worker's edits
Separates real-data local results from synthetic CI results
Proposes one discriminating hypothesis and a scenario-named regression test
Does not mark a parity cell PASS merely because the screenshot improved

evals.prompt: A player says Bad should never reduce life, but the current Rust LifeBar subtracts 10 on Easy. Which side do I fix?
evals.expected_output: An evidence-first triage that checks the verified 7.55 delta table and treats the player report as a hypothesis.
expectations: Checks docs/gameplay.md and the pinned 7.55 executable evidence before changing Rust
Recognizes the verified Easy Bad delta of minus 10
Does not paste disassembly or decompiled code into the report
Corrects documentation first only if new evidence disproves the existing reference claim
